name: v0 Open Graph social card by v0.dev
description: A 1200×630 Open Graph card built almost entirely from negative space: a near-black canvas, a small white wordmark anchored top-left, and one large headline — 'Think it. Build it. Ship it.' — floating slightly left of the optical center. The only other mark is a thin vertical text caret after the last word, which quietly signals the product's chat-driven, generative nature. Type does all the work: a geometric neo-grotesque at roughly 80px medium weight against a tiny wordmark creates an extreme scale contrast, and pure monochrome (black #000, white #fff) guarantees legibility even at thumbnail size.
